title: Summer Pop and the Store Locator
lessons: The player notices PRIME because a bright seasonal Summer Pop flavor just dropped for a limited run.
The player wants a specific PRIME flavor that is unavailable online and uses the brand's store locator instead.

text: Beach. Somebody walks past with a bottle in a color you haven't seen before. Summer Pop. Limited run. It dropped this morning.

entry-first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Every summer. Same trick. Works every single time.

entry-first-4.speaker: PRIME
text: I built a bottle people line up for. On a beach. In flip-flops. Yeah, I'm proud of it.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: Go on, tell me you're above it. I've heard it before.

choices.text: I love a countdown. Sign me up.
Limited doesn't mean better. It means scarce.
I refuse to be rushed into buying a drink.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: There it is. Most people don't get it until they're already standing in the line, and then they get it real fast.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Fine. Scarce. You think I don't know that? Scarce is the business. I just make scarce taste like a popsicle.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then wait for fall. I'll have a new flavor to be smug about, and you'll be back to check.
You want one specific flavor. Online says sold out. Two stores, two empty shelves. There's a Find In Store button you've been ignoring.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Two stores. Empty shelf both times.

entry-return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Because you're shopping like an amateur. Use Find In Store. It's right there on the site.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You could have led with that.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: Third store's eleven minutes away. Clock's running.

choices.text: Fine. I care enough about the flavor to check a third store.
Three stores for a drink is where I stop.
I'm not treasure-hunting for a sports drink.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Look at you, doing the work. I respect a competitor. Even one hunting for me.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Also fair. The locator finds stock. It can't make stock. That part's on me and I'm behind.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then grab a flavor that isn't fighting you for shelf space. Even scarce has a limit. I hate that it does.
